name: Ebb
author: Erin Carter
description: A falling tide leaves a scatter of glowing pools stranded across dark wet sand, each a mirror-bright fill rimmed by a thin meniscus. Over a long cycle the tide retreats and pools drain one by one, until a single luminous up-sweep rolls through and refills them all at once.

params.label: Cycle speed
params.effect: Rate of the whole retreat-and-refill cycle; higher values shorten the long ebb and bring the refill sweep around sooner.

params.label: Pool size
params.effect: Characteristic CSS-pixel radius of the stranded pools; larger pools merge into ragged connected shallows.

params.label: Drain stagger
params.effect: Spread of per-pool drain timing: 0 dims every pool in unison, 1 strings them out one by one across the ebb.
